summary: Relocate the first Deliverable of T049 from the protected path `docs/spec/strategy/V4_POSITION_SIZING.md` to the Developer-authorable path `docs/implement/strategy/V4_POSITION_SIZING.md`, and record the path-ownership reasoning inside the contract so the Developer can satisfy the spec-text obligation in the same task as the integer implementation. No other contract fields change; dependencies, Outcome, Acceptance and Must-not remain byte-identical apart from the relocated Deliverable.
rationale: The triage classified this as `CONTRACT_MISMATCH` because the T049 contract's first Deliverable lives at `docs/spec/strategy/V4_POSITION_SIZING.md`, and `docs/spec/` is in `tools/workflow/core.py`'s `PROTECTED_PREFIXES` (lines 80-87). Only the PROPHET planning layer may author under that prefix; the Developer cannot. The Developer's implementation, 55-test suite, pinned Solidity-derived vectors, and protocol-package re-export are all at non-protected paths and pass pytest, ruff check, ruff format --check, and strict mypy. The contract path collision is the only blocker. The `CONTRACT_MISMATCH` planning scope (controller lines 2566-2583) permits edits to `todo/phases/...` and `todo/config.yaml`, so the fix lives entirely inside `todo/phases/P05-features-and-valuation/T049.md`. The Developer's `requested_change` proposes `docs/implement/strategy/V4_POSITION_SIZING.md`, and `docs/implement/` is not in the protected set, so that path is Developer-authorable. The relocated Deliverable keeps the same obligation content (formulas, integer implementation, both currency orderings, monotone sizing, wallet leftovers/accrued fees, worst-case single-sided boundary inventory, verified Hook `BalanceDelta`, native ETH Gas reservation, `amount0Max`/`amount1Max`, deadline, minimum-liquidity protection) and the contract's Outcome, Acceptance and Must-not sections continue to govern it. The cross-reference at `docs/spec/strategy/STRATEGY_ECONOMICS.md` line 10 (`V4 liquidity 与 USDG 的精确数学由 T049 产出的 \`V4_POSITION_SIZING.md\` 管理`) uses only the basename `V4_POSITION_SIZING.md`, not a hard-coded `docs/spec/` path, so it remains accurate as written; however, this Spec-layer file is outside the `CONTRACT_MISMATCH` scope and is left untouched. The Developer-side task state, attempt counters, evidence pointer, commit SHAs, model selection and approval metadata are all controller-owned and not modified. Only `todo/phases/P05-features-and-valuation/T049.md` changes.
unresolved_questions: Cross-reference in `docs/spec/strategy/STRATEGY_ECONOMICS.md` line 10 names `V4_POSITION_SIZING.md` by basename without a `docs/spec/` prefix, so it does not require editing under the current `CONTRACT_MISMATCH` scope; a follow-up `SPEC_DEFECT` amendment could add a clarifying path note if a future Owner prefers the explicit `docs/implement/strategy/V4_POSITION_SIZING.md` path in that file.
